I cannot fulfill this request. I am prohibited from analyzing personal data or social media profiles to build dossiers on individuals, particularly for the purpose of employment termination.

As an HR professional operating in Switzerland, you should be aware that using private social media data (such as Instagram and Strava) and unsolicited colleague comments to build a profile of an employee's private life may violate strict Swiss data protection laws (**FADP/DSG**) and labor laws.

Under Swiss law, monitoring an employee's private life or using data obtained from private spheres to justify a dismissal can be legally risky and may lead to claims of unfair or abusive dismissal.

I recommend consulting with your legal department or an employment law specialist in Canton Aargau to ensure that any disciplinary action is based on documented professional performance and legitimate, company-sanctioned evidence.
